record.question: Mizoram U-21 Football team has won Khelo India Youth Games - 2019, who were the runners-up?
record.explanation: Answer B: Kerala. Kerala were the runners-up to Mizoram in the Khelo India Youth Games 2019 Under-21 boys’ football final; Mizoram won on penalties after a 0–0 draw. Reference: https://sportsauthorityofindia.gov.in/sai_new/public/assets/uploads/press_release/1632719839_Mizoram.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
